description: BELBİM Inc.: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by BELBİM Inc.. Coverage: BELBİM Inc.. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Yıllara Göre İstanbulKart Ulaşım Dışı Kullanım Verileri; Toplu Ulaşımda İstanbulkart Harici Geçiş Verisi; Electronic Ticket Pass Data Used in Public Transport. Formats seen: XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
